purpose: taxids for 11 clade/species names by label, batch 6
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> SELECT ?t ?l WHERE { ?t rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(REGEX(STR(?t),'NCBITaxon_[0-9]+$')) FILTER(REGEX(STR(?l), "^(Canis lupus familiaris|Exocoetus volitans|Hirundichthys speculiger|Cypselurus hiraii|Hirundichthys affinis|Escherichia coli|Cupriavidus necator|Ideonella sakaiensis|Mus musculus|Saccharomyces cerevisiae|Caenorhabditis elegans)( <[^>]*>)?$")) }
